name: HIVE (HIerarchical Volume Encoding)
definition: A plug-and-play module for neural implicit surface reconstruction that explicitly encodes spatial information using hierarchical feature volumes to capture high-frequency details and enforce spatial consistency, replacing or augmenting the implicit encoding of MLPs.
summary: HIVE is a hierarchical volume encoding module that captures high-frequency details and enforces spatial consistency by combining low-resolution volumes with sparsified high-resolution volumes, reducing memory consumption.
